counting_rule.canonical_record: One source-of-record scholarly work or one versioned operational resource record.
counting_rule.independent_family: For dataset-compatibility evidence, records sharing the same upstream dataset lineage count once; adapters, packages, mirrors, and method papers reusing the same dataset are dependencies, not independent dataset evidence.
